landing.heroSubtitle: Unify multiple Lovable accounts, find any project in seconds and save up to 2 hours per week in productivity.
landing.heroSubtitle2: With Cursor, Base44 and other smart integrations, you centralize everything in one place and work much more efficiently.
landing.securityNote: Your Keys are stored only on your device (localStorage) — we never send them to the cloud
landing.problemSubtitle: If you use Lovable, Cursor, Base44 and other smart integrations, you've probably been through this:
landing.problemTimeLostDesc: You spend precious minutes every time you need to find a project in another account.
landing.problemManualSearchDesc: Without centralized search, you manually navigate through dozens of projects.
landing.problemOverloadDesc: Remembering which project is in which account is tiring and unproductive.
landing.problemDisorganizationDesc: Without tags, favorites or filters, your projects become a mess.
landing.solutionSubtitle: Central Opus Flow centralizes all your Lovable, Cursor, Base44 accounts and other integrations in a smart dashboard, so you can find any project in seconds.
landing.solutionInstantSearchDesc: Find any project by typing Ctrl+K. Search across all accounts at once.
landing.solutionVisualOrgDesc: Colorful tags, favorites and filters so you never lose a project.
landing.solutionFullViewDesc: Stats, credits and status of all projects in real time.
landing.audienceSubtitle: If you use Lovable, Cursor, Base44 and other integrations, Central Opus Flow will transform the way you work.
landing.audienceFreelancersDesc: Organize projects from different clients without wasting time.
landing.audienceAgenciesDesc: Manage dozens of projects from multiple clients with ease.
landing.audienceDevelopersDesc: Keep your personal and professional projects organized.
landing.audienceCreatorsDesc: Track all your experiments and published projects.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
landing.faq1Q: How does the free trial work?
landing.faq1A: You have 15 days to use all features of Central Opus Flow without providing a credit card. At the end of the period, choose to subscribe or continue with limited access.
landing.faq2Q: How many Lovable, Cursor, Base44 and other integration accounts can I connect?
landing.faq2A: With the Pro plan, you can connect unlimited accounts from Lovable, Cursor, Base44 and other integrations. There's no limit on the number of projects or accounts you can manage.
landing.faq3A: Yes. We use encryption on all connections, your data is stored on secure servers, and you can export or delete everything at any time. We don't share information with third parties.
landing.faq4A: We accept PIX for monthly or annual payments. After confirmation, your access is immediately activated. You can cancel at any time, without penalties.
landing.faq5Q: Can I use it with my team?
landing.faq5A: Currently Central Opus Flow is focused on individual use, but you can share projects and accounts with collaborators. Advanced team features are under development.
landing.faq6A: You keep access until the end of the paid period. After that, your account reverts to limited free mode, but your data is saved for 90 days in case you want to reactivate.
landing.faq7Q: Does Central Opus Flow sync automatically with Lovable, Cursor and Base44?
landing.faq7A: Projects are managed manually in Central Opus Flow. You add the project information you want to track and update status, notes and progress as needed.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join hundreds of creators who already use Central Opus Flow to manage their projects efficiently.
